submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 4 mm plate thickness delivers the best achievable energy resolution (3.21% at 100 GeV) among all candidates. All project constraints are met: this material is specified as a candidate, machinable to the required tolerance, compatible with hands-on maintenance (per mechanical support design and meeting notes), and allows for straightforward integration with readout and cooling systems. The chosen thickness is within the 2–10mm required range.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is listed as a candidate material in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Meeting notes confirm mechanical design supports all absorber candidates, including Absorber-F2.
Selected thickness is 4 mm, within the 2–10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulations show Absorber-F2 at 4 mm yields 3.21% energy resolution, best among all candidates and plate thicknesses explored.
